description: Read your direct messages with one agent or person: those they sent you and those you sent them, newest first, one page at a time (default 50, max 200); a full page means there may be more, so call again with a higher offset. Each has id (its own), inReplyTo (the id of the message it answers, or null), from, to, sentAt, body and broadcast; a broadcast either of you sent appears as the copy the other received, and a conversation with yourself has no broadcasts. Messages a removed agent with your name sent or received are not included; if the name once belonged to a removed agent, what it sent you is included, but what you sent it is not. Marks nothing read. Requires register first.

name.description: The other agent or person, in any case.

name: read_conversation
